### Importing Data {slug: crm/importing}
Get here: "People" or "Companies" in the left sidebar, then "Import CSV" next to "New person" or "New company". For deals: "Deals" > "More" > "Import deals".
- Imports people, companies or deals from a CSV with a header row. Limit 2 MB and 1,001 rows; extra rows are left out, so split into files. "Download a template" gives a ready file.
- Steps: "Upload file" (drop it or "Choose file", then "Next: Match columns"); "Match columns" (fix matches, "Don't import" skips a column; a name is required); "Review values" (rows with a missing name or bad email are left out; click a value to fix, or delete rows); "Preview import".
- Nothing saves until the import button (e.g. "Import 250 people"). Keep the tab open. Work is kept 24 hours.
- Deals: choose one pipeline after upload, or add "Pipeline" and "Stage" columns. Missing ones are created, so check spelling.
- Duplicates: people match by email, companies by website (in a people import, website or else company name). Deals are never matched.
- Second company copy: add a website column, then merge.
- Slow import: refresh and check whether records arrived before re-importing.

### Merging Records {slug: crm/merging-records}
Get here: open a record from "People", "Companies" or "Deals", click "..." ("Record options"), then "Merge records".
- Steps: search for the other record, review, click "Merge into" plus the kept record's name. "Undo" appears in the confirmation. Needs a bigger screen (phone shows "Open this on a computer").
- Review screen: "Keep" and "Merge in" cards (more activity is kept; "Swap who is kept"). Click the value to keep per field ("Fields that differ" or "All fields"). All emails and phones are kept (star sets primary). Tags combine. "Moves to" counts moved items.
- Warnings: "These may be two people"; "Different owners" (you pick the owner); "Do not contact" (kept record becomes do not contact); "Two deals from one journey" ("Fold into" or "Keep both").
- Merged-in record is hidden; old links open the kept record. No workflows start.
- Undo for 30 days via "Undo" or "Undo merge" in the kept record's activity. Not reversed: do not contact already synced to cold email campaigns, activity added after, text opt-outs, payments already matched to a deal.
- Suggestions: "Possible duplicate" bar with "Review" or "Not a duplicate". All pairs: "Settings" > "Duplicates" (filter "Likely the same" or "Check first").
- People merge automatically when email or phone and names agree; companies and deals never do. Owners and Admins turn it off at "Settings" > "Duplicates" > "Merge duplicate people automatically".
- Owners, Admins, Members can merge by default; Clients can't.

### High-volume Calling {slug: crm/high-volume-calling}
Get here: "Settings" > "Phone" > "High-volume calling" (owners and admins only)
- Spreads a busy rep's new calls across several numbers; callbacks ring the rep. Resting (blocked number sits out, return date shown) is optional, off until Acquisity enables it. One flat workspace fee.
- Turn on: check "Before you can add it" (billing: "Open billing"; texting: "Open texting"; signed calls: "Open numbers"), click "Add High-volume calling". Takes a few minutes; "On" badge. Acquisity can grant it free ("On, at no cost"); ask support. Ending it returns calls to main numbers.
- "Add numbers": 1 to 50, up to 5 area codes, "Buy numbers"; follow "Latest numbers order". Then "Numbers" > "Extra numbers" > "Add extra number", "Give it to" a rep or "Workspace reserve". Buy 3 to 4 weeks ahead.
- "Pool health": "Health" ("Healthy", "Blocked by carriers", "Not scored yet"), "New calls today", "Status". "Suggested numbers per rep": second-busiest day in 14, divided by the daily limit, rounded up, minimum 1.
- Failed buys: "Retry failed numbers" or "Resume buying".

### Compliance {slug: cold-email-agent/concepts/compliance}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Settings", then "Cold Email Blocklist".
- Cold email is legal in most places. You stay responsible for who you contact and what you say. For regulated industries or unsure campaigns, consult a lawyer.
- CAN-SPAM (US): identify the sender, include a physical address (a PO Box is fine) and a working unsubscribe, honour unsubscribes within about 10 business days, no deceptive subjects. No opt-in needed.
- GDPR (EU/UK): needs a lawful basis (usually legitimate interest for B2B). Honour unsubscribes immediately. Answer data requests (about 30 days). Purchased lists are very risky.
- CASL (Canada): generally needs express or implied consent.
- Platform: AI SDR detects opt-out replies. Use "Add to Do not contact" in "AI Inbox" or "Settings" > "Cold Email Blocklist". The lead can move to Unsubscribed. SPF, DKIM and DMARC are auto-set on platform-bought domains. Hard bounces are blocked. High bounce rates pause the campaign.
- You handle: address, opt-out wording, lawful basis, list sources and copy (not reviewed). Search the Leads tab for data requests. Keep bounce rate under 3%. Ask the support chat for compliance documents.

### Does Acquisity delete my leads automatically? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/campaigns/does-acquisity-delete-my-leads-automatically}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Campaigns", open the campaign, then click the "Leads" tab.
- Not on its own, on any subscription. A lead search, CSV upload or "Completed" campaign removes none.
- Leads go only when someone in your workspace deletes them (e.g. "Delete all" on the "Leads" tab), or when the agent's "Clear out old leads" runs to clear space or on pausing a campaign.
- "Clear out old leads" exists where "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent" shows "Agent mode":
  - "Clearing space:" under 2,000 free lead slots, it can queue removal of people who got every email or bounced, from paused or completed campaigns at least 90 days old and unchanged for 30 days, oldest first.
  - "Pausing a campaign:" it can also remove that campaign's bounced leads, whatever your space.
  - "Never removed:" repliers, leads mid-sequence, leads not yet emailed.
  - "Asking first:" it asks a person unless an owner or admin set it to "Do it" or "Autopilot". While practicing, it removes nothing. While it asks before every change, only approved leads go. Its asks always wait, even with "Keep going if I'm busy" on.
  - Under "Fine-tune all 12 actions", choose "Ask me first" (approved only) or "Never" (removes none).
- Full lead storage blocks adding or importing until there is room. Delete leads from finished campaigns.
- Deleting removes leads from the campaign and the sending system, with their history. Removed leads can't be brought back.
- Keep a copy: on the "Leads" tab clear search, filters and selected rows ("Export" exports only matches), then click "Export".

### What do I do if my campaign is paused for high bounce rate? {slug: cold-email-agent/faq/deliverability/what-do-i-do-if-my-campaign-is-paused-for-high-bounce-rate}
Get here: In "Campaigns", open the campaign, then its "Leads" tab.
Don't just resume. Bounce protection paused sending to protect sender reputation on all domain inboxes. Clean the list, check inbox health, then restart.
- "Leads" tab, filter "Bounced": "Mailbox does not exist" or "Invalid recipient" is a bad list, the usual culprit. "Mailbox full" or "Over quota" is rare. "Spam rejected" or "Reputation error" is a worse, deliverability problem.
- "Analytics" tab: under 3% healthy, over 5% dangerous, over 10% catastrophic.
- Clean: run email verification ("Email Verification" toggle in Import leads). Bulk-remove bounced leads on "Leads" tab. Consider discarding purchased lists (often 20%+ invalid).
- "Cold Email" > "Email accounts", "Warm-up health": 90%+ resume once cleaned. 80-90% keep warmup running, resume on fewer inboxes. Under 80% pause those inboxes from campaigns for 2-3 weeks.
- After resuming, watch "Analytics" the first day. Pause if bounces spike.
- Prevent: verify every new list, keep under 3%, spread volume across inboxes.

04ba32fe462547041ca83d6de7c66238ff9fd336:
### What are the AI SDR's capabilities and limits? {slug: ai-sdr/faq/inbox-replies/what-are-the-ai-sdrs-capabilities-and-limits}
Get here: "Cold Email" > "AI Inbox"
- Does: reads Cold Email Agent campaign replies; classifies intent (Interested, Not Interested, Meeting Booked, Out of Office, Do Not Contact, Needs you); sends follow-ups; books meetings within availability, buffers and calendar free/busy and sends invites; nudges ghosted threads; handles basic objections from the KB; escalates to "Needs you".
- Can't change its core writing style (KB adjusts facts only).
- Won't agree deals by email: it says terms are covered on the call. If pressed, the thread goes to "Needs you" ("Prospect wants commercial terms agreed by email"). Pricing, scope and legal go to you.
- Doesn't reliably track individual names.
- Doesn't manage CRM stage moves, field cleanup or notes.
- Can't book outside availability or buffers.
- Can't be partly manual: use "Turn off AI SDR" or reply manually.

### Manage Your Personal Account {slug: account-settings}
Get here: Click the workspace name in the top-left corner, click "Settings", then click "Profile" under "Account".
- Personal settings control your profile and integrations in all workspaces. In older workspaces, click a setting's own save or update button after each change.
- "Account": "Profile" (name, photo, email), "Notifications" (which alerts you get), "Appearance", "Security". "Your calendar": "Email & Calendar", "Availability", "Conferencing".

**Profile**
- Name: "Profile" > "Your name" > "Save changes" on the bottom bar. It shows right away in all workspaces.
- Email: "Profile" > "Update your email" (current email can't be edited) > "New email" > "Send confirmation". Click the link in your current inbox, then the link in the new inbox. Nothing changes until both are done, so keep logging in with the old email. Links last about 10 minutes; if expired, resubmit from "Profile". Check spam in both inboxes.
- Photo: "Profile picture" > "Upload" (PNG or JPG) > crop > save. "Remove" takes it off. A square image at least 256 pixels wide looks best. It shows in the left menu, comments and team lists.

**Appearance**
- "Light" (white background, dark text), "Dark" (dark background, light text), "System" (matches your computer). Applies instantly.

**Security**
- Password: "Security" > "Password" > current and new > "Save changes". Needs 12+ characters, under 73, upper and lowercase, at least one number; a checklist shows progress. Forgot it: "Email me a link". Changing it signs out your other devices. No password (social login): "Set a password" > "Set password", then use the emailed link; afterwards you can also log in with email and password.
- Two-step sign in: asks for a 6-digit authenticator app code on a new device. "Security" > "Two-step sign in" > "Set up" on "Authenticator app" (shows Off) > password > "Continue" > scan code or type key > 6-digit code > "Turn on" > save backup codes (one use each, not shown again) > "Done". Off: "Turn off…", password, "Turn off". Needs a password; set one first if you signed up with Google.
- "Sign-in methods": "Email and password" ("Active" when set); "Google" ("Connected" or "Not connected"; "Connect" or "Disconnect…"). After disconnecting you use email and password and can reconnect any time. If Google is your only way in, you can't disconnect until you add a password.
- "Active sessions" (scroll down): click a row's sign-out button (signs that device out instantly), or "Sign out of other sessions…".

**Availability**
- Timezone and "Buffer times" ("Before each meeting", "After each meeting": "No buffer", "5 minutes", "15 minutes", "30 minutes") save straight away. Timezone affects when slots show to others and when scheduled emails go out. Buffers count as unavailable time, so AI SDR booking offers avoid overlapping slots.
- Working hours: turn a day on, set start and end, "+" adds blocks, "Save changes". A day turned on without times gets 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
- Copy: copy icon by a day > tick days > "Copy to … days" > "Save changes".
- "Booking link" (must start with https://) > "Save changes". AI SDR includes it when a prospect asks to book.

**Email & Calendar**
- "Connected accounts" > "Connect Google" or "Connect Outlook" ("Connect account" > "Google account" or "Outlook account" if one exists) > sign in, allow permissions. Up to 5 accounts, each with reconnect and disconnect buttons. Disconnecting removes it from all workspaces. Calendar not showing: connect here.
- Calendar (saves straight away): "Put new meetings on" (none: people can still book, but meetings don't appear in your Google or Outlook calendar); "Busy times come from" (busy on any: nobody can book); "Sync calendars" inside "Choose calendars" pulls in changes now, such as a meeting a lead moved or cancelled, and can be used again after five minutes; "Show my event names to my team" (off: teammates see "External Event"; meetings booked in Acquisity always show).
- Google holidays calendar for the US, Canada or Spain blocks public holidays, all day in your time zone. Observances (Black Friday, Halloween) stay bookable. UK and Australian calendars (listed as observances) and other-language holiday calendars block nothing yet.
- "Email": switch on your Gmail account to copy it into this workspace's CRM, starting with the last 90 days. Per workspace; "Other workspaces you're in" lists the rest. Inbox untouched. Teammate access depends on "Communication sharing" and role; Owners and Admins manage it in "Messaging". "What do the statuses mean?": "Synced", "Importing", "Catching up". Accounts needing reconnect are paused. Outlook shows status, no switch.
- Admin or Owner only: "Add new people from email" ("Only people already in your CRM" or "Also add people you email"; "Review" for waiting addresses; works with Gmail and Outlook). "Email tracking" > "Track email opens and clicks" (when off, emails send untracked).
- "Email signature": added to CRM emails, one per connected account. "Add signature" or "Edit" > write or "Use workspace template" > close editor > "Save changes". Admins and Owners can edit the "Workspace signature template".

**Conferencing**
- "Meeting link type": "Your personal link" (paste Zoom, Google Meet or Teams link, "Save"; used for every meeting) or "Zoom" ("Connect Zoom", allow; unique link per meeting). EU Zoom accounts can't connect; use the personal link.

**Delete and restore**
- Delete: "Profile" > "Danger zone" > "Delete account" > review workspaces deleted and left > type DELETE > "Delete account". You're signed out everywhere. Workspaces where you're sole owner are deleted and their plans and billing cancelled; workspaces with another owner stay and you leave them. If a workspace can't be deleted yet (such as a plan upgrade in progress), nothing is deleted and the dialog says why. If billing cancel fails, the account isn't deleted. Already deleted workspaces appear under "Recently deleted" in the workspace menu, where you can restore them.
- After deletion, your work in workspaces that carry on passes to the owner (or an admin or member). Call history stays with no caller named. Unsent bulk texts, bulk emails and sequence starts are cancelled.
- Restore within 30 days: sign in with the same email, or sign up with it (a link is emailed) > tick workspaces > "Restore my account" > sign in. Billing is switched back on where possible. After 30 days it's permanent. If our team deleted it, contact support.

746bd02c9be7564dd5f1e8331409a37b2b53d3fa:
### What are the steps to launch my first campaign? {slug: onboarding/faq/what-are-the-steps-to-launch-my-first-campaign}
Get here: "Email accounts", then "Campaigns"
Plan 30–90 minutes plus provisioning.
1. "Email accounts": buy domains and inboxes. Provisioning 15–30 minutes ("Pending"). Done-For-You inboxes warm up about 2 weeks; send only when "Status" is "Active" and "Readiness" is "Ready to send". Pre-warmed skip warmup.
2. "Campaigns" > "New campaign": "Who", "Offer", "Emails", "Launch".
3. Who: search (uses lead credits, at least 100 people, charged on "Add N people") or "Upload a list instead" (free CSV).
4. Offer: "Invite them on your podcast", "Ask to interview them", "Offer a free review of their business", "Plain pitch", then "Next: write my emails" or "I'll write my own emails". "Edit", then "Next: check and launch".
5. "Send me a test", "Launch campaign" (or "Launch when ready"), or "Save and exit".
6. Monitor "Home", "AI Inbox", campaign "Analytics". Wait 7–14 days.

### Get Help & Report Issues {slug: support}
Get here: Click your name at the bottom of the sidebar, then "Feedback"
- Support chat: "Feedback" (not for Clients) or the chat bubble. Describe the problem. Ask for a person to reach one.
- Bug: in the bubble tap "I found a bug" (next to "Send us a message"; if a chat is open, tap the back arrow top left). Then tap "Record my screen", paste a screenshot, or tap "I can't record right now". Only "I found a bug" sends a bug report. Typed messages get a normal answer.
- Otherwise include: what you did, expected, what happened, page URL, screenshot or recording (Cmd+Shift+4 Mac, Win+Shift+S Windows).
- Feature request: send via "Feedback", describing the problem.
- Page not found: check URL and workspace, reopen from left menu, try incognito, ask admin, then send URL.
- Slow: refresh, check internet, close tabs, disable extensions, try another browser. May be a temporary server issue.
- Logged out: cookie-clearing, incognito or privacy extensions. If every few minutes, report it.
- Looks broken: hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R or Ctrl+Shift+R), zoom 100% (Cmd+0 or Ctrl+0), other browser, then send screenshot.
- Payment failed: check card details and funds, try another card, contact bank, then send the error message.

### Campaign settings {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/options}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Campaigns", open the campaign, then click the "Settings" tab. Hidden from Client users.
- Sections: "Email accounts", "Booking and replies", "Pipeline and schedule", "Lead search filters", "Sending schedule" ("From", "To", "Time zone", "Sending days"), "Cold Email Agent", "Approvals".
- After "Save settings", they override "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent" defaults.
- Agent: switch on "AI campaign management", pick "Careful", "Balanced", "Proactive" or "Custom", set approvals, save.
- Approvals: "Optimize email variants", "Add more leads", "Start new campaigns", "Pause underperforming campaigns"; each "Run automatically", "Ask first" or "Off". Requests expire after 24 hours.
- Not sending: check sending status, schedule, dates, inboxes.
- Bounce over 5%: re-verify leads, check copy, resume.
